_meta.description: Fraud investigation policy rules for HHGOA hackathon.
_meta.source: Derived entirely from statistical analysis of closed_cases_history.csv (5,565 closed cases). No explicit policy document was found in the repository. Each rule documents its evidence base.
_meta.warning: These rules are INFERRED from data patterns, not from a published policy document. They should be treated as working hypotheses. Rule derivation methodology is documented in docs/POLICY_MODEL.md.

risk_score_trigger.description: Minimum risk_score to trigger a case review.
risk_score_trigger.source: case_pack.csv — lowest risk_score in benchmark set is 0.52 (HHG-020). Customer reports have no score threshold.

card_not_present_fraud.description: Online purchases inconsistent with cardholder's usual merchants and amounts.

account_takeover.description: Card account accessed or controlled by an unauthorized party.

card_not_present_new_device.description: Card-not-present fraud originating from a new or unknown device.

out_of_region_use.description: Card-present use in a billing region the cardholder has no transaction history in, while cardholder retained the card.

card_testing.description: Multiple small transactions in a short window, typically before larger fraud attempt.

undocumented.description: Complex scheme with connected cards forming a ring. Always requires SAR filing.

none.description: No fraud found — case cleared after investigation.

rules.name: mandatory_case_creation
rules.description: Any qualifying trigger must result in a case record.
rules.source: All 5,565 closed cases have a case_id — no trigger goes uninvestigated.

rules.name: mandatory_block_on_confirmed_fraud
rules.description: Every confirmed fraud case must block the card.
rules.source: 4,665 of 4,665 confirmed_fraud cases include BLOCK_CARD. Zero exceptions.

rules.name: sar_filing_threshold
rules.description: File a Suspicious Activity Report when confirmed fraud exposure reaches the threshold, or for undocumented pattern regardless of amount.
rules.source: Statistical analysis: max unfiled confirmed_fraud exposure = USD 999.95. All 9 undocumented pattern cases filed SAR regardless of amount. Threshold inferred as USD 1,000.
rules.caveat: No official policy document confirms USD 1,000 threshold. May differ from FinCEN standard USD 5,000.

rules.name: cleared_case_protocol
rules.description: When investigation finds no fraud evidence, verify with customer then close.
rules.source: 900 of 900 cleared cases follow exactly VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER | CLOSE_NO_FRAUD. Zero cases with BLOCK_CARD or FILE_REPORT among cleared.

rules.name: customer_report_high_prior_probability
rules.description: Customer explicitly disputing a transaction has high prior fraud probability even if model risk score is low.
rules.effect: Treat initial evidence sufficiency threshold as lower; customer_report provides strong evidence requiring investigation even below risk score threshold.
rules.source: 6 of 20 benchmark cases are customer_report with no risk_score. Historical cleared cases (16.2%) show some are false positives, requiring VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER.

permitted_actions.description: Open a new investigation case record.
Block the flagged card from further transactions.
Contact the cardholder to confirm whether the transaction was authorized.
Close case with no fraud finding.

permitted_actions.prerequisite: outcome == confirmed_fraud AND (exposure_usd >= 1000 OR pattern == undocumented)

forbidden_actions.reason: Never observed in historical data for cleared cases.
Never observed in historical data for cleared cases.
